D_800102B8.name: kaze_common_tex02_tim_path

D_800102CC.name: kaze_common_tex01_tim_path

D_800102E0.name: kaze_common_console_tim_path

D_80010308.name: kaze_texture_tbl_file_path

D_8001031C.name: kaze_env_lookup_vram_rect

D_80010324.name: kaze_post_event_grid_area_rect1
D_80010324.rationale: Copied into r1 and passed to SetDrawArea (offset by outer<<8 in y per page) in kaze_post_event_grid_prim_init, sizing the post-event grid panel's first draw area.

D_80010354.name: kaze_default_normal_vector
D_80010354.rationale: Copied into a local SVECTOR and passed straight to NormalColor() in kaze_lighting_env_frame_update to compute the base ambient color.

D_800104C8.name: kaze_seq_vh_filename_fmt
D_800104C8.rationale: Doc comment for kaze_seq_vab_bank_load_33d2c says it 'opens VH (SsVabOpenHeadSticky)' first; sprintf with this format builds that VH filename.

D_800104D0.name: kaze_seq_vb_filename_fmt

D_800104D8.name: kaze_seq_sep_filename_fmt
D_800104D8.rationale: Same function's doc comment says it 'opens the SEP sequence (SsSepOpen)'; this format builds the SEP filename.

D_800104E0.name: kaze_tim_load_error_msg
D_800104E0.rationale: printf(D_800104E0) with no args is called only when a loaded TIM's magic word is not 0x10, i.e. an invalid-TIM error message.

D_800104F0.name: kaze_file_path_drive_prefix

D_800104F4.name: kaze_memcard_device_path
D_800104F4.rationale: kaze_memcard_format's doc comment: 'Builds the device name from DAT_800104f4'; also used directly as the memory-card device path base in kaze_memcard_file_read.

D_800104F8.name: kaze_memcard_device_path_tail

D_800104FC.name: kaze_memcard_file_glob_pattern
D_800104FC.rationale: S7 pattern copied into 'name' and passed to firstfile()/nextfile() in kaze_memcard_file_count to enumerate save files.

D_80010514.name: kaze_opening_demo_model_path

D_80010524.name: kaze_opening_demo_txp_path

D_80010534.name: kaze_map_bg_tile_present_table
D_80010534.rationale: kaze_map_tiles_draw's doc comment: 'AddPrims the map background tile SPRTs flagged present in the DAT_80010534 8x10 table'.

D_80010584.name: kaze_start_zone_excl_table_mode1

D_8001058C.name: kaze_start_zone_excl_table_mode2

D_8001059C.name: kaze_start_zone_excl_table_mode0
D_8001059C.rationale: Used under the mode_zero label (kaze_menu_stage_source==0), 9-entry zone exclusion list.

D_800105A8.name: kaze_skip_start_x_tile_table

D_800105A9.name: kaze_skip_start_z_tile_table
D_800105A9.rationale: Same function's byte b1, scaled by 0xed8 into kaze_staged_start_z's tile coordinate.

D_800105AA.name: kaze_skip_start_wind_table
D_800105AA.rationale: Same function's byte b2 is stored directly into kaze_staged_start_wind_dir.

D_800105FC.name: kaze_menu_bg_tim_path
D_800105FC.rationale: File already carries an inline comment /* "BAL\\K\\MBG.TIM" */ on this extern declaration.

D_8001060C.name: kaze_menu_model_pack_path

D_8001061C.name: kaze_menu_model_txp_path
D_8001061C.rationale: Same function's doc comment: '...then loads BAL\K\GM.TXP textures.'

D_80010674.name: kaze_balloon_prm_alt_path

D_80010684.name: kaze_balloon_prm_path
D_80010684.rationale: Default balloon design pack path BAL\K\BALL.PRM per the same doc comment (default branch).

D_8001070C.name: kaze_mode_panel_uv_u_table
D_8001070C.rationale: kaze_setup_menu_mode_panel_prim_init's doc comment: 'uv from DAT_8001070c/DAT_80010710 tables' for the three mode-choice panel SPRTs; assigned into uv_u.

D_80010710.name: kaze_mode_panel_uv_v_table
D_80010710.rationale: Same doc comment's second UV table, assigned into uv_v.

D_80010714.name: kaze_variant_stage_source_table
D_80010714.rationale: kaze_grid_select_teardown reads this (stride 3, indexed by variant-1) into kaze_menu_stage_source.

D_80010715.name: kaze_variant_flags_source_table
D_80010715.rationale: Same function, adjacent byte in the same stride-3 record, written into kaze_menu_flags_source.

D_80010716.name: kaze_variant_level_source_table
D_80010716.rationale: Same function, third byte of the stride-3 record, written into kaze_menu_level_source.

D_80010730.name: kaze_variant_weather_source_table
D_80010730.rationale: Same function, single-byte-per-variant table (stride 1, indexed by variant-1) written into kaze_menu_weather_source.

D_8001076C.name: kaze_header_sprite_clut_x_table
D_8001076C.rationale: kaze_options_header_sprites_init's doc comment: 'CLUT coords from ROM tables DAT_8001076c/DAT_8001077c'; used as tbl[0] (a0, the GetClut x argument).

D_8001077C.name: kaze_header_sprite_clut_y_table
D_8001077C.rationale: Same doc comment's second CLUT-coord table, used as tbl[1] (a1, the GetClut y argument).

D_800108F8.name: kaze_record_default_initial0_table
D_800108F8.rationale: kaze_record_table_reset_defaults's doc comment: ROM default table at DAT_800108f8 holding 'name chars + value per entry'; this is the first name-char byte of each 8-byte record.

D_800108F9.name: kaze_record_default_initial1_table
D_800108F9.rationale: Second name-char byte of the same 8-byte default record table.

D_800108FA.name: kaze_record_default_initial2_table
D_800108FA.rationale: Third name-char byte of the same 8-byte default record table.

D_800108FC.name: kaze_record_default_value_table
D_800108FC.rationale: Int 'value' field of the same 8-byte default record table, per the doc comment's 'name chars + value per entry'.

D_80010AA8.name: kaze_records_tab_underline_w_table

D_80010AB0.name: kaze_records_tab_underline_h_table

D_80010AB8.name: kaze_save_icon_clut

D_80010AD8.name: kaze_save_icon_frame0
D_80010AD8.rationale: 0x80-byte icon frame memcpy'd into the save image's common (non-rare) icon-data path, per the doc comment's icon-data DAT_80010ad8 reference.

D_80010B58.name: kaze_save_icon_frame1

D_80010BD8.name: kaze_save_icon_frame2
D_80010BD8.rationale: Third 0x80-byte icon frame, also shared between both branches of the save icon packing.

D_80010C58.name: kaze_save_icon_frame0_rare

D_80010DF4.name: kaze_save_file_name

D_80010EC8.name: kaze_status_strip_glyph_table
D_80010EC8.rationale: kaze_slot_overlay_add_status_strip's doc comment: 'message glyph byte from the DAT_80010ec8 table (index 2 or 8)'.

D_80010ED8.name: kaze_ending_balloon_model_path
D_80010ED8.rationale: kaze_ending_balloon_model_load's doc comment: loads the balloon model 'BAL\T\BALL.MDL'.

D_80010EE8.name: kaze_ending_full_tim_path
D_80010EE8.rationale: kaze_ending_state_reset's doc comment: uploads 'BAL\T\FULL.TIM' to VRAM; this string is loaded then passed straight to kaze_tim_load_to_vram there.

D_80010EF8.name: kaze_ending_txp_path
D_80010EF8.rationale: kaze_ending_textures_load's doc comment: 'Loads BAL\T\END.TXP and uploads each TIM to VRAM'; this is the first load in that function.

D_80010F08.name: kaze_ending_txp2_path
D_80010F08.rationale: Same function's second load, matching the doc comment's 'then loads BAL\T\END2.TXP'.

D_8008C6A4.name: kaze_mode1_target_x_table
D_8008C6A4.rationale: Per-stage target table indexed by kaze_stage_index*0x10 in kaze_mode1_slot_populate, matching architecture.md's documented mode-1 target x values (241300/245100/233700 per stage).

D_8008C6A8.name: kaze_mode1_target_y_table

D_8008C6AC.name: kaze_mode1_target_z_table
D_8008C6AC.rationale: Parallel per-stage table for the target z coordinate, same indexing as D_8008C6A4.

D_8008C704.name: kaze_mode1_target_variant2_x
D_8008C704.rationale: Overrides slot0's x when kaze_stage_variant==2, matching architecture.md's documented variant-2 override (427500, 0, 349600).

D_8008C708.name: kaze_mode1_target_variant2_y
D_8008C708.rationale: Overrides slot0's y in the same variant==2 branch.

D_8008C70C.name: kaze_mode1_target_variant2_z
D_8008C70C.rationale: Overrides slot0's z in the same variant==2 branch.

D_8008C714.name: kaze_cd_root_cache_node
D_8008C714.rationale: kaze_cd_file_cache_root_init's doc comment: allocates the 0x1c-byte root record into DAT_8008c714, the head of the cached CD directory tree used by kaze_cd_file_lookup_cached.

D_8008C718.name: kaze_str_frame_cached_width
D_8008C718.rationale: kaze_str_next_frame_fetch's doc comment: 'updates cached width/height (DAT_8008c718/DAT_8008c71c) on resolution change'.

D_8008C71C.name: kaze_str_frame_cached_height
D_8008C71C.rationale: Same doc comment, the paired cached-height field.

D_8008C720.name: kaze_dynobj_placement_table_0
D_8008C720.rationale: architecture.md: dynamic-object placement table for stage 0, 0x40-byte records, spawned via kaze_dynamic_object_spawner.

D_8008CBA0.name: kaze_dynobj_placement_table_1
D_8008CBA0.rationale: architecture.md: dynamic-object placement table for stage 1, same record format as D_8008C720.

D_8008D020.name: kaze_dynobj_placement_table_2
D_8008D020.rationale: architecture.md: dynamic-object placement table for stage 2, same record format as D_8008C720.

D_8008D4A0.name: kaze_route_node_next_table
D_8008D4A0.rationale: In dynobj_anim.c route-follow logic, indexed by node*0x10 to read the next-node index (nx), which becomes the object's new node cursor.

D_8008D4A4.name: kaze_route_node_x_table
D_8008D4A4.rationale: Same 0x10-byte-stride node table, read right after the next-index to populate param_1[0x15] (the object's route target x).

D_8008D4A8.name: kaze_route_node_y_table
D_8008D4A8.rationale: Same node table, next field read into param_1[0x16] (route target y/height component).

D_8008D4AC.name: kaze_route_node_z_table
D_8008D4AC.rationale: Same node table's final field, read as next_z, the route target z component.

D_8008D9A0.name: kaze_min_gas_base_table
D_8008D9A0.rationale: kaze_min_gas_init's doc comment: 'Initializes kaze_min_gas from per-mode static tables at DAT_8008d9a0..DAT_8008d9ac shifted left 12', indexed by stage level and selected by kaze_stage_flags.

D_8008D9D4.name: kaze_radar_wind_needle_x_offsets
D_8008D9D4.rationale: In kaze_minimap_radar_builder, indexed by the 8-direction wind-angle bucket (temp_s0) and added to the needle sprite's x field (+0x496d4).

D_8008D9E4.name: kaze_radar_wind_needle_y_offsets
D_8008D9E4.rationale: Same function, parallel table added to the needle sprite's y field (+0x496d6).

D_8008D9F4.name: kaze_sound_state_base_ptr
D_8008D9F4.rationale: kaze_sound_system_init's doc comment: 'allocates the 0x14b20 sound work area into DAT_8008d9f4'; used as a base pointer (base+0x14acX etc.) throughout the sound subsystem, analogous to kaze_state_base_ptr.

D_8008D9F8.name: kaze_demo_attract_mode_pool
D_8008D9F8.rationale: 3-entry table randomly indexed (rand()%3) to seed kaze_staged_stage_index[2] (mode) in kaze_demo_attract_runner_34478.

D_8008DA04.name: kaze_demo_attract_variant_pool
D_8008DA04.rationale: 4-entry table randomly indexed (rand()%4) to seed kaze_staged_stage_index[3] (variant) in the same attract-mode runner.

D_8008DA14.name: kaze_xa_filename_table
D_8008DA14.rationale: kaze_xa_file_table_init_331c's doc comment: 'resolving \BAL\STR\BALXA01.XA entries' from this char* table into packed CdlLOC fields.

D_8008DA1C.name: kaze_xa_file_index_table
D_8008DA1C.rationale: Same function, int table used to select which filename in D_8008DA14 corresponds to each of the 16 XA location-table slots.

D_8008DA20.name: kaze_xa_track_default_volume_table
D_8008DA20.rationale: In kaze_xa_audio_start_track_3384c, indexed by track<<4 and compared against/written into the sound state's current-volume byte (+0x14af1) when starting a track.

D_8008DA24.name: kaze_xa_file_loc_table
D_8008DA24.rationale: Populated by kaze_xa_file_table_init_331c as the packed CdlLOC (24-bit CD location) table, then read per-track in kaze_xa_audio_start_track_3384c to seek the CD.

D_8008DA28.name: kaze_xa_track_length_table
D_8008DA28.rationale: In kaze_xa_audio_start_track_3384c, indexed by track*4 to read the track's sector length, added to the start sector to compute the end sector.

D_8008DB1C.name: kaze_seq_vab_name_table
D_8008DB1C.rationale: VH/VB name pointer table (stride 0x10) used to build .VH/.VB filenames in kaze_seq_vab_bank_load_33d2c, matching its header comment order.

D_8008DB20.name: kaze_seq_sep_name_table
D_8008DB20.rationale: SEP sequence name pointer table used to build the .SEP filename, per the same header comment order.

D_8008DB24.name: kaze_seq_id_table
D_8008DB24.rationale: seq id table passed to SsSepOpen and stored as the track count, per the header comment ('/* seq id */').

D_8008DB28.name: kaze_seq_vab_id_table
D_8008DB28.rationale: vab id table passed as the third arg to SsVabOpenHeadSticky, per the header comment ('/* vab id */').

D_8008DB3C.name: kaze_sfx_note_table
D_8008DB3C.rationale: note table indexed by SFX voice number, passed to SsVoKeyOn/SsVoKeyOff per their doc comments.

D_8008DBE0.name: kaze_task_record_index
D_8008DBE0.rationale: indexes the balloon/task record pointer table D_800B2DB8 and is one of the 'options' unpacked from a save slot per kaze_save_verify_unpack_full's doc comment.

D_8008DBE4.name: kaze_task_name_letter0_table
D_8008DBE4.rationale: stride-3 signed-char array holding letter 0 of each task's 3-letter name, indexed by kaze_task_record_index*3.

D_8008DBE5.name: kaze_task_name_letter1_table
D_8008DBE5.rationale: same underlying array as D_8008DBE4 offset by 1 byte; records_screen.c copies it as (&D_8008DBE5)[idx*3], the record's letter 1.

D_8008DBE6.name: kaze_task_name_letter2_table
D_8008DBE6.rationale: same underlying array offset by 2 bytes; copied as (&D_8008DBE6)[idx*3], the record's letter 2.

D_8008DBF4.name: kaze_title_vertex_remap_table_a
D_8008DBF4.rationale: index table used to reorder title model vertices via base[D_8008DBF4[i]].vx/vy/vz in title_render_setup.c.

D_8008DC04.name: kaze_title_vertex_remap_table_b
D_8008DC04.rationale: second index table used the same way (base[*a1]) for a second vertex set right after D_8008DBF4's loop.

D_8008DC14.name: kaze_button_action_map
D_8008DC14.rationale: per-button assigned action id table, edited by kaze_button_remap_assign/kaze_button_map_find_action and persisted to/from the save slot data.

D_8008DC1C.name: kaze_settings_toggle_a
D_8008DC1C.rationale: first of two boolean option toggle bytes, edited by the settings 'toggle row' input and copied into a staged flag destination in kaze_settings_menu_dispatch; persisted in the save slot.

D_8008DC1D.name: kaze_settings_toggle_b
D_8008DC1D.rationale: second toggle byte, immediately after D_8008DC1C, used identically (copied to D_800B199C, persisted alongside D_8008DC1C).

D_8008DC20.name: kaze_task_grid_available_flags
D_8008DC20.rationale: stride-3 per-stage flags gating which task-grid prim cells are drawn in grid_select.c; unpacked from the save slot's 'bit flags' per kaze_save_verify_unpack_full's doc comment.

D_8008DC29.name: kaze_grid_variant_saved_index
D_8008DC29.rationale: persisted grid-variant selection (sentinel 9 = unset) restored from/to the save slot in save_slot_overlay.c and grid_select.c.

D_8008DC2A.name: kaze_sound_mode_setting
D_8008DC2A.rationale: stereo/mono XA-stream mode value set by kaze_sound_mode_input and applied via kaze_xa_stream_enable_33b0/kaze_xa_stream_disable_33e8.

D_8008DC2B.name: kaze_game_menu_entered_flag
D_8008DC2B.rationale: set to 1 by kaze_game_menu_mode_init; checked by the title flow to jump directly to title state 2, per kaze_game_menu_mode_init's doc comment.

D_8008DC2C.name: kaze_drmove_wipe_height_table_0
D_8008DC2C.rationale: one of the four per-column height tables (UNK_8008dd58/de84/dfb0/DAT_8008dc2c) for the DR_MOVE wipe/dissolve grid, per kaze_drmove_wipe_tiles's doc comment.

D_8008DD58.name: kaze_drmove_wipe_height_table_1
D_8008DD58.rationale: second of the four wipe-tile height tables, selected when the wipe style param is 1, per the same doc comment.

D_8008DE84.name: kaze_drmove_wipe_height_table_2
D_8008DE84.rationale: third of the four wipe-tile height tables, selected when the wipe style param is 2, per the same doc comment.

D_8008DFB0.name: kaze_drmove_wipe_height_table_3
D_8008DFB0.rationale: fourth of the four wipe-tile height tables, selected when the wipe style param is 3, per the same doc comment.

D_8008E0DC.name: kaze_memcard_poll_retry_count
D_8008E0DC.rationale: counter reset to 0 on card-slot state changes and incremented on the 'do_incr' retry path in memcard_poll.c, guarded against a 0x79 cap.

D_8008E0E0.name: kaze_title_screen_cleanup_flag

D_8008E0E4.name: kaze_title_pressstart_sprite_buffer

D_800A71BC.name: kaze_str_movie_end_flag

D_800A71C0.name: kaze_str_movie_stream_count

D_800A71C4.name: kaze_str_vlc_buffer_a

D_800A71D0.name: kaze_str_mdec_buffer_a

D_800A71D4.name: kaze_str_mdec_buffer_b

D_800AAB88.name: kaze_memcard_slot0_event_a

D_800AAE08.name: kaze_title_screen_state

D_800AAE10.name: kaze_title_next_state

D_800AAE2C.name: kaze_title_press_start_cycle_count

D_800AAE50.name: kaze_title_fade_blend_mode

D_800AAE58.name: kaze_opening_model_loaded_flag

D_800AAE5C.name: kaze_opening_model_file_ptr
D_800AAE5C.rationale: Holds the result of kaze_file_load_by_name(D_80010514) (BAL\\K\\OPN.MDL) in kaze_opening_demo_init; used as the base pointer for kaze_opening_model_link's header offsets and freed via kaze_heap_free.

D_800AAE60.name: kaze_opening_model_data_ptr
D_800AAE60.rationale: In kaze_opening_model_link, set to a pointer computed from the loaded opening model file (D_800AAE5C header offset) that is then advanced and passed to GsMapModelingData.

D_800AAE64.name: kaze_opening_model_link_handle
D_800AAE64.rationale: Zeroed and passed by address as the second GsLinkObject4 argument in kaze_opening_model_link, then read back in kaze_opening_model_sort ('h = &D_800AAE68' indirection) as the linked-object handle.

D_800AAE68.name: kaze_opening_model_coord_ptr
D_800AAE68.rationale: Set to &D_800AAE74 in kaze_opening_model_link (the coordinate2 struct address) and read via GsGetLws in kaze_opening_model_sort to fetch the light/world matrices.

D_800AAE74.name: kaze_opening_model_coord2
D_800AAE74.rationale: Base of the GsCOORDINATE2 struct built by GsInitCoordinate2(0, &D_800AAE74) in kaze_opening_model_link for the opening balloon model.

D_800AAE78.name: kaze_opening_model_matrix
D_800AAE78.rationale: 4 bytes into the D_800AAE74 coordinate2 struct; RotMatrix writes the opening model's rotation matrix here and GsSortObject4 reads it for rendering.

D_800AAEC4.name: kaze_opening_model_rot_x
D_800AAEC4.rationale: First of three u16 zeroed together in kaze_opening_model_link and passed as &D_800AAEC4 (an SVECTOR) to RotMatrix in kaze_opening_model_sort, i.e. the opening model's rotation angle vector.

D_800AAEC6.name: kaze_opening_model_rot_y

D_800AAEC8.name: kaze_opening_model_rot_z
D_800AAEC8.rationale: Third u16 of the D_800AAEC4 rotation angle vector consumed by RotMatrix(&D_800AAEC4, m) in kaze_opening_model_sort.

D_800AAECC.name: kaze_opening_model_pos_x
D_800AAECC.rationale: First int of the translation vector passed as &D_800AAECC to kaze_trans_matrix(m, &D_800AAECC) in kaze_opening_model_sort, i.e. the opening model's world position.

D_800AAED0.name: kaze_opening_model_pos_y

D_800AAED4.name: kaze_opening_model_pos_z
D_800AAED4.rationale: Third int of the D_800AAECC translation vector consumed by kaze_trans_matrix in kaze_opening_model_sort.

D_800AAEDC.name: kaze_opening_camera_keyframe_frames

D_800AAEE4.name: kaze_opening_camera_pitch_delta

D_800AAEE8.name: kaze_opening_camera_dx_delta

D_800AAEEC.name: kaze_opening_camera_dz_delta

D_800AAEF0.name: kaze_opening_camera_keyframe_index

D_800AAEF8.name: kaze_map_screen_ot_table

D_800AAEFC.name: kaze_map_screen_prim_ot_ptr

D_800AAF3C.name: kaze_map_wind_overlay_phase

D_800AAF44.name: kaze_map_target_marker_pulse_phase

D_800AAF48.name: kaze_map_scroll_arrow_pulse

D_800AAF60.name: kaze_menu_fade_transition_state

D_800AAF74.name: kaze_main_menu_selected_item

D_800AAF78.name: kaze_main_menu_prev_item

D_800AE2D0.name: kaze_ending_light0_dir_x

D_800AE32C.name: kaze_ending_ot_buffer_b

D_800AE330.name: kaze_ending_packet_buffer_a

D_800AE334.name: kaze_ending_packet_buffer_b

D_800AE360.name: kaze_ending_camera_matrix

D_800AE3B4.name: kaze_ending_camera_pos_x

D_800AE3B8.name: kaze_ending_camera_pos_y
D_800AE3B8.rationale: kaze_ending_camera_init/reset_defaults zero this as the y component of the ending camera's position vector.

D_800AE3C8.name: kaze_ending_camera_roll

D_800AE408.name: kaze_ending_backdrop_scroll_y

D_800AE6E0.name: kaze_ending_credits_substate

D_800AE6E8.name: kaze_ending_debug_toggle_flag

D_800AE700.rationale: rcos(bob_phase)>>0xb result added to the balloon's Y position in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step per the doc comment.

D_800AE704.name: kaze_ending_path_start_x

D_800AE710.name: kaze_ending_path_end_x
D_800AE710.rationale: Segment end X used to compute dx = end_x - x in kaze_ending_path_segment_setup.

D_800AE714.name: kaze_ending_path_end_y
D_800AE714.rationale: Segment end Y used to compute dy in kaze_ending_path_segment_setup.

D_800AE718.name: kaze_ending_path_end_z
D_800AE718.rationale: Segment end Z used to compute dz in kaze_ending_path_segment_setup.

D_800AE71C.name: kaze_ending_path_delta_x
D_800AE71C.rationale: abs(dx) DDA range term compared against the accumulators in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE720.name: kaze_ending_path_delta_y
D_800AE720.rationale: abs(dy) DDA range term compared against the accumulators in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE724.name: kaze_ending_path_delta_z
D_800AE724.rationale: abs(dz) DDA range term compared against the accumulators in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE728.name: kaze_ending_path_error_x
D_800AE728.rationale: DDA error accumulator for the X axis, incremented each step and reduced by the dominant-axis delta in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE72C.name: kaze_ending_path_error_y
D_800AE72C.rationale: DDA error accumulator for the Y axis in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE730.name: kaze_ending_path_error_z
D_800AE730.rationale: DDA error accumulator for the Z axis in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE734.name: kaze_ending_path_step_x
D_800AE734.rationale: Signed per-frame speed step applied to the X position, sign set from dx in kaze_ending_path_segment_setup.

D_800AE738.name: kaze_ending_path_step_y
D_800AE738.rationale: Signed per-frame speed step applied to the Y position in kaze_ending_path_segment_setup/kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE73C.name: kaze_ending_path_step_z
D_800AE73C.rationale: Signed per-frame speed step applied to the Z position in kaze_ending_path_segment_setup/kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE740.name: kaze_ending_path_progress
D_800AE740.rationale: Accumulates by kaze_ending_path_speed along the dominant axis and is compared against the axis delta to end the segment in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step.

D_800AE744.name: kaze_ending_path_speed
D_800AE744.rationale: Keyframe 'speed' field loaded in kaze_ending_keyframe_load and used as the DDA step increment.

D_800AE748.name: kaze_ending_path_dominant_axis
D_800AE748.rationale: Selects which axis (0/1/2) drives the DDA stepper in kaze_ending_balloon_path_step, computed in kaze_ending_path_segment_setup.

D_800AE750.name: kaze_ending_asset_load_buffer_ptr
D_800AE750.rationale: Reused scratch pointer for END.TXP/END2.TXP/FULL.TIM file loads across kaze_ending_textures_load/kaze_ending_state_reset, freed in kaze_ending_buffers_free.

D_800AE754.name: kaze_ending_balloon_model_ptr
D_800AE754.rationale: Holds the BAL\T\BALL.MDL load result per the kaze_ending_balloon_model_load doc comment and is freed in kaze_ending_buffers_free.

D_800AE758.name: kaze_ending_credit_page_texture_table
D_800AE758.rationale: Array of per-page sub-image offsets filled in kaze_ending_textures_load and indexed by the credit-page index for VRAM upload.

D_800AE788.name: kaze_ending_music_track_id
D_800AE788.rationale: XA track id passed to kaze_xa_audio_manager_35a0 each frame in kaze_ending_screen_loop; -2 means no music, matching the doc comment.

D_800B0E60.name: kaze_gs_view_pos_x
D_800B0E60.rationale: Menu 3D view translation X; doc comment 'Resets view position DAT_800b0e60..68' in kaze_gs_view_init_92c8, also set in kaze_gs_view_set_pose_94c8.

D_800B0E64.name: kaze_gs_view_pos_y
D_800B0E64.rationale: Menu 3D view translation Y, part of the DAT_800b0e60..68 view position triple.

D_800B0E68.name: kaze_gs_view_pos_z
D_800B0E68.rationale: Menu 3D view translation Z, part of the DAT_800b0e60..68 view position triple.

D_800B0E78.name: kaze_memcard_slot_status_flags
D_800B0E78.rationale: Per-slot decoded memcard status bit array written by kaze_memcard_result_decode and read by kaze_memcard_slot_select/kaze_memcard_slot_select_draw.

D_800B0E7C.name: kaze_memcard_slot1_status_flags
D_800B0E7C.rationale: Second slot's decoded status flags, checked alongside D_800B0E78[0] in kaze_memcard_slot_select/kaze_memcard_slot_select_draw.

D_800B0E88.name: kaze_gs_packet_buffer_a_ptr
D_800B0E88.rationale: 0x1000-byte GS packet buffer allocated in kaze_gs_graphics_init_9170 and freed in kaze_gs_graphics_free_9270.

D_800B0E8C.name: kaze_gs_packet_buffer_b_ptr
D_800B0E8C.rationale: Second 0x1000-byte GS packet buffer, allocated/freed alongside D_800B0E88 in kaze_gs_graphics_init_9170/_free_9270.

D_800B0E98.name: kaze_input_current_pad2_mask
D_800B0E98.rationale: Decoded from the port-2 digital pad buffer (D_800B192A..) and ORed into kaze_input_current_a in kaze_pad_mask_update.

D_800B0EA4.name: kaze_input_pad2_mask_current
D_800B0EA4.rationale: Per-frame snapshot of D_800B0E98 taken in kaze_pad_edge_latch_update, used as the 'current' operand for pad2 new-press detection.

D_800B0EA8.name: kaze_gs_disp_buff_x0
D_800B0EA8.rationale: Stores the x0 parameter of the double-buffer display origin in PsyQ kaze_gs_def_disp_buff.

D_800B0EAA.name: kaze_gs_disp_buff_x1
D_800B0EAA.rationale: Stores the x1 parameter of the double-buffer display origin in PsyQ kaze_gs_def_disp_buff.

D_800B0F44.name: kaze_gs_disp_buff_y0
D_800B0F44.rationale: Stores the y0 parameter of the double-buffer display origin in PsyQ kaze_gs_def_disp_buff.

D_800B0F46.name: kaze_gs_disp_buff_y1
D_800B0F46.rationale: Stores the y1 parameter of the double-buffer display origin in PsyQ kaze_gs_def_disp_buff.

D_800B0F4C.name: kaze_input_pad1_hold_counter
D_800B0F4C.rationale: Reset to 0 when the pad1 mask changes, else incremented each frame in kaze_pad_edge_latch_update.

D_800B0F54.name: kaze_input_pad2_hold_counter
D_800B0F54.rationale: Reset to 0 when the pad2 mask changes, else incremented each frame in kaze_pad_edge_latch_update.

D_800B1448.name: kaze_gs_light0_dir_x
D_800B1448.rationale: First word of the GsF_LIGHT block passed to GsSetFlatLight(0,...) in kaze_gs_light_init_default_93b0/_alt_9454.

D_800B144C.name: kaze_gs_light0_dir_y
D_800B144C.rationale: Second word of the flat-light direction vector set in kaze_gs_light_init_default_93b0/_alt_9454.

D_800B1450.name: kaze_gs_light0_dir_z
D_800B1450.rationale: Third word of the flat-light direction vector set in kaze_gs_light_init_default_93b0/_alt_9454.

D_800B1454.name: kaze_gs_light0_color_r
D_800B1454.rationale: Red color byte of the GsF_LIGHT block, set to 0xff/0x00 in kaze_gs_light_init_default_93b0/_alt_9454.

D_800B1455.name: kaze_gs_light0_color_g
D_800B1455.rationale: Green color byte of the GsF_LIGHT block in kaze_gs_light_init_default_93b0/_alt_9454.

D_800B1456.name: kaze_gs_light0_color_b
D_800B1456.rationale: Blue color byte of the GsF_LIGHT block in kaze_gs_light_init_default_93b0/_alt_9454.

D_800B1498.name: kaze_gs_view_coord2
D_800B1498.rationale: GsCOORDINATE2 struct for the menu view, initialized via GsInitCoordinate2 in kaze_gs_view_init_92c8 and cleared (.flg) in kaze_gs_view_set_pose_94c8.

D_800B149C.name: kaze_gs_view_matrix
D_800B149C.rationale: View rotation MATRIX rebuilt via RotMatrix and used for GsSetView2 in kaze_gs_view_set_pose_94c8, per the doc comment.

D_800B14E8.name: kaze_input_action_button_mask
D_800B14E8.rationale: Remappable button binding defaulting to Square (0x80) in kaze_input_poll and stored as remap slot 4 in kaze_settings_menu_dispatch; used for a new-press check in world_update.c/kaze_pause_exit_prompt.c.

D_800B14F8.name: kaze_menu_render_rot_x
D_800B14F8.rationale: Scratch rotation copied from kaze_menu_camera_rot_x and fed to RotMatrix in kaze_title_model_sort_shadow; reset in balloon_editor.c/kaze_task_menu_enter_init.c.

D_800B14FA.name: kaze_menu_render_rot_y
D_800B14FA.rationale: Scratch rotation copied from kaze_menu_camera_rot_y in kaze_title_model_sort_shadow.

D_800B14FC.name: kaze_menu_render_rot_z
D_800B14FC.rationale: Scratch rotation copied from kaze_menu_camera_rot_z in kaze_title_model_sort_shadow.

D_800B1514.name: kaze_input_prev_pad2_mask
D_800B1514.rationale: Latches the previous frame's D_800B0E98 pad2 mask in kaze_pad_mask_update, compared for edge detection.

D_800B1530.name: kaze_gs_draw_buff_clip_x0
D_800B1530.rationale: Draw-buffer clip rect x0, set from GsDefDispBuff params (or zeroed in interlace mode) in kaze_gs_def_disp_buff.

D_800B1532.name: kaze_gs_draw_buff_clip_x1
D_800B1532.rationale: Draw-buffer clip rect x1 in kaze_gs_def_disp_buff.

D_800B1534.name: kaze_gs_draw_buff_clip_y0
D_800B1534.rationale: Draw-buffer clip rect y0 in kaze_gs_def_disp_buff.

D_800B1536.name: kaze_gs_draw_buff_clip_y1
D_800B1536.rationale: Draw-buffer clip rect y1 in kaze_gs_def_disp_buff.

D_800B153C.name: kaze_input_pad1_mask_previous
D_800B153C.rationale: Per-loop copy of kaze_input_current_b used as the 'previous' operand for the pad1 new-press mask in kaze_pad_edge_latch_update.

D_800B1540.name: kaze_input_pad2_mask_previous
D_800B1540.rationale: Per-loop copy of D_800B1514 used as the 'previous' operand for the pad2 new-press mask (paired with D_800B0EA4) in kaze_pad_edge_latch_update.

D_800B1548.name: kaze_memcard_slot_request_state
D_800B1548.rationale: Raw card-library request/event state bits (info/load/clear pending) per slot, driven by _card_info/_card_load/_card_clear in kaze_memcard_slot_poll_start/kaze_memcard_state_machine.

D_800B154C.name: kaze_memcard_slot1_request_state
D_800B154C.rationale: Second slot's raw card-library request state, checked alongside D_800B1548 in kaze_memcard_state_machine/kaze_memcard_slot_select_draw.

D_800B1558.name: kaze_gs_work_base_ptr
D_800B1558.rationale: Stores the current GPU packet work-area pointer set each frame by kaze_gs_set_work_base per its doc comment.

D_800B15D0.name: kaze_title_shadow_line_verts_a
D_800B15D0.rationale: SVECTOR[4] holding one endpoint set of the title shadow lines, filled in kaze_title_shadow_line_setup and transformed via RotTransPers in title_model_sort.c.

D_800B15F0.name: kaze_title_shadow_line_verts_b
D_800B15F0.rationale: SVECTOR[4] holding the other endpoint set of the title shadow lines, filled in kaze_title_shadow_line_setup and transformed via RotTransPers in title_model_sort.c.

D_800B1654.name: kaze_ss_vm_damper_flag
D_800B1654.rationale: PsyQ SPU voice-manager damper flag set/cleared by kaze_ss_vm_damper_on/_off per their doc comments.

D_800B1698.name: kaze_menu_mode_preview_tim_table
D_800B1698.rationale: Array of TIM ids indexed by kaze_menu_mode_source and uploaded to VRAM in kaze_setup_menu_mode_texture_upload; also a resolved section pointer from the menu model pack in kaze_menu_model_load.

D_800B16D0.name: kaze_grid_select_reentry_flag
D_800B16D0.rationale: Mirrors kaze_staged_stage_variant in kaze_game_menu_mode_init and seeds the initial grid-select state (1 vs 0) in kaze_grid_select_init; cleared on exit in kaze_grid_select_confirm_result.

D_800B16F8.name: kaze_balloon_scale_x
D_800B16F8.rationale: Defaults to 0x1000 (unity fixed point) with D_800B16FC/D_800B1700 and is passed as a 3-component vector to ScaleMatrix in balloon_draw.c; animated in kaze_pause_exit_prompt.c.

D_800B16FC.name: kaze_balloon_scale_y
D_800B16FC.rationale: Second component of the balloon ScaleMatrix vector, defaults to 0x1000 and is squashed via rsin(D_800B1734) in kaze_pause_exit_prompt.c.

D_800B1700.name: kaze_balloon_scale_z
D_800B1700.rationale: Third component of the balloon ScaleMatrix vector, defaults to 0x1000 and is stretched via rsin(D_800B1734) in kaze_pause_exit_prompt.c.

D_800B171A.name: kaze_balloon_render_rot_y
D_800B171A.rationale: Sits between kaze_balloon_render_rot0 (0x800b1718) and kaze_balloon_render_rot1 (0x800b171c) as consecutive shorts, all zeroed together in kaze_game_state_defaults_init as the balloon render rotation vector.

D_800B172A.name: kaze_balloon_sway_offset_y
D_800B172A.rationale: Computed as rsin(D_800B1730)*10>>0xc in kaze_pause_exit_prompt.c/objective_markers.c and added to a render vertex offset in balloon_draw.c.

D_800B1730.name: kaze_balloon_sway_phase
D_800B1730.rationale: Angle accumulator advanced by a state-based rate (*(state+0xa4)*0x20 & 0xfff) whose rsin() drives kaze_balloon_sway_offset_y in kaze_pause_exit_prompt.c/objective_markers.c.

D_800B1734.name: kaze_impact_flash_timer
D_800B1734.rationale: Reset to 0x4000 on every collision/landing bump (flight_scene.c, kaze_object_physics_snapshot.c, objective_spawn.c), decays each frame in kaze_wind_motion_update.c and gates state flag 0x80 when low.

D_800B1738.name: kaze_burner_hold_charge
D_800B1738.rationale: Accumulates by delta*0x20 while the burner-hold bit is set in kaze_pause_exit_prompt.c, caps at 0x1000 to trigger success/failure, and is zeroed in kaze_landing_goal_handler's terminal path.

D_800B1790.name: kaze_input_bind_descend
D_800B1790.rationale: Default Cross mask (input_defaults.c); held state increases the gas-floor drop rate in kaze_gas_floor_reset (collision.c), i.e. a quick-descend button binding.

D_800B17D0.name: kaze_input_bind_left
D_800B17D0.rationale: input_defaults.c sets it to 0x8000 which kaze_input_poll's doc comment labels Left; used as the left-dpad mask in kaze_camera_control_update/objective_spawn.

D_800B17F0.name: kaze_menu_camera_trans_x
D_800B17F0.rationale: title_model_sort.c passes &D_800B17F0 as the 3-word translation vector to kaze_trans_matrix after RotMatrix, seeded from kaze_menu_camera_pos_x in balloon_editor.c/kaze_task_menu_enter_init.c.

D_800B17F4.name: kaze_menu_camera_trans_y
D_800B17F4.rationale: Second word of the menu-camera translation vector (D_800B17F0..F8); set from kaze_menu_camera_scroll+0x180 in title_model_sort.c.

D_800B17F8.name: kaze_menu_camera_trans_z
D_800B17F8.rationale: Third word of the menu-camera translation vector; set from kaze_menu_camera_pos_z in title_model_sort.c.

D_800B1800.name: kaze_cd_stream_start
D_800B1800.rationale: kaze_st_set_mask.c doc: PsyQ StSetMask stores its 'mask/start/rewind' params into DAT_800b55f0/DAT_800b1800/DAT_800b55e8 respectively, so this is the 'start' parameter (a1).

D_800B1804.name: kaze_ss_mono_flag
D_800B1804.rationale: spu_stereo.c: kaze_ss_set_mono sets it to 1 and kaze_ss_set_stereo clears it to 0 (PsyQ SsSetMono/SsSetStereo mono-output flag).

D_800B1808.name: kaze_input_bind_down
D_800B1808.rationale: input_defaults.c sets it to 0x4000, the Down mask per kaze_input_poll's doc comment; used as the down-dpad mask in kaze_camera_control_update.

D_800B1890.name: kaze_camera_anchor_target_x
D_800B1890.rationale: objective_markers.c: kaze_approach_value(ANCH_X, D_800B1890[ROUTE*8], ...) smooths the menu-camera anchor X toward this per-route default table (200/0x708/0x10 seeded in game_defaults.c).

D_800B1894.name: kaze_camera_anchor_target_y
D_800B1894.rationale: objective_markers.c smooths ANCH_Y toward D_800B1894[ROUTE*8]; default 200 seeded in game_defaults.c.

D_800B1898.name: kaze_camera_anchor_target_z
D_800B1898.rationale: objective_markers.c smooths ANCH_Z toward D_800B1898[ROUTE*8]; default 0x708 seeded in game_defaults.c; also compared in kaze_object_physics_snapshot.c.

D_800B18A0.name: kaze_camera_control_speed_x
D_800B18A0.rationale: kaze_camera_control_update (objective_markers.c) multiplies D_800B18A0[ROUTE*8] by the per-frame step to move the manual-camera X offset on dpad input.

D_800B18A4.name: kaze_camera_control_speed_y
D_800B18A4.rationale: Same function uses D_800B18A4[ROUTE*8] as the per-route Y-axis manual camera speed table.

D_800B18B0.name: kaze_camera_anchor_route1_x
D_800B18B0.rationale: objective_markers.c compares ANCH_X==D_800B18B0 (with route==1) to detect the manual camera reached its route-1 goal position.

D_800B18B4.name: kaze_camera_anchor_route1_y
D_800B18B4.rationale: Same completion check compares ANCH_Y==D_800B18B4 for route 1; default -0x32 in game_defaults.c.

D_800B18B8.name: kaze_camera_anchor_route1_z
D_800B18B8.rationale: Same completion check compares ANCH_Z==D_800B18B8 for route 1.

D_800B1908.name: kaze_pad1_buffer
D_800B1908.rationale: kaze_system_boot_init.c passes &D_800B1908 to InitPAD as the 0x22-byte pad-1 buffer; kaze_pad_mask_update.c reads its status byte D_800B1909 for the type nibble.

D_800B1909.name: kaze_pad1_type_byte
D_800B1909.rationale: kaze_pad_mask_update.c checks (D_800B1909>>4)==4 (digital-pad type) before decoding pad-1 buttons.

D_800B190A.name: kaze_pad1_buttons_hi
D_800B190A.rationale: kaze_pad_mask_update.c builds kaze_input_current_a from (D_800B190A<<8)|D_800B190B ^ 0xFFFF, the raw pad-1 button bytes.

D_800B190B.name: kaze_pad1_buttons_lo
D_800B190B.rationale: Low byte of the raw pad-1 button word decoded alongside D_800B190A in kaze_pad_mask_update.c.

D_800B192A.name: kaze_pad2_status_byte
D_800B192A.rationale: kaze_pad_mask_update.c checks D_800B192A==0 before decoding pad 2, mirroring the D_800B1908 pad-1 status byte.

D_800B192B.name: kaze_pad2_type_byte
D_800B192B.rationale: kaze_pad_mask_update.c checks (D_800B192B>>4)==4 for pad 2's type nibble, mirroring D_800B1909.

D_800B192C.name: kaze_pad2_buttons_hi
D_800B192C.rationale: kaze_pad_mask_update.c builds D_800B0E98 from (D_800B192C<<8)|D_800B192D ^ 0xFFFF, the raw pad-2 button bytes.

D_800B192D.name: kaze_pad2_buttons_lo
D_800B192D.rationale: Low byte of the raw pad-2 button word decoded alongside D_800B192C in kaze_pad_mask_update.c.

D_800B199C.name: kaze_camera_invert_pitch
D_800B199C.rationale: kaze_settings_menu_dispatch.c loads it from save byte D_8008DC1D; kaze_camera_control_update (objective_markers.c) negates the up/down camera delta (local[0]) when it is nonzero.

D_800B19A0.name: kaze_camera_invert_yaw
D_800B19A0.rationale: kaze_settings_menu_dispatch.c loads it from save byte D_8008DC1C; kaze_camera_control_update negates the left/right camera delta (local[1]) when nonzero.

D_800B19AC.name: kaze_menu_camera_matrix
D_800B19AC.rationale: balloon_editor.c: RotMatrix(&kaze_menu_camera_rot_x, &D_800B19AC) then kaze_trans_matrix(&D_800B19AC, ...) -- the rotation-matrix scratch for the menu camera transform.

D_800B19F8.name: kaze_menu_camera_coord_word
D_800B19F8.rationale: title_model_sort.c stores kaze_menu_camera_coord_flags into *coord where coord=&D_800B19F8; zeroed in balloon_editor.c/kaze_task_menu_enter_init.c on menu entry.

D_800B1A4C.name: kaze_menu_screen_mode
D_800B1A4C.rationale: kaze_game_menu_master_loop.c doc: 'dispatches DAT_800b1a4c modes (0 main select, 1 setup, 2/4/5 sub-screens) until 8/9'; written by every menu screen (main_menu.c, setup_menu.c, memcard_menu.c, options_menu.c, ...).

D_800B1AA8.name: kaze_menu_vcount_timestamp
D_800B1AA8.rationale: Every menu loop assigns it GsGetVcount() (main_menu.c, grid_select.c, memcard_screen.c, ...); memcard_screen.c derives an XA seek position from it, i.e. a frame-count timestamp.

D_800B1AB4.name: kaze_input_bind_right
D_800B1AB4.rationale: input_defaults.c sets it to 0x2000, the Right mask per kaze_input_poll's doc comment; used as the right-dpad mask in kaze_camera_control_update.

D_800B1AD8.name: kaze_record_table_a
D_800B1AD8.rationale: kaze_records_screen_init doc: 'copies the 3x3x6 record table DAT_800b1ad8'; base of the RecordEntry{a,b,c,pad,score} array, byte a.

D_800B1AD9.name: kaze_record_table_b
D_800B1AD9.rationale: records_screen.c/save_slot_overlay.c access it as RecordEntry.b, one byte past D_800B1AD8 in the same 8-byte-stride record table.

D_800B1ADA.name: kaze_record_table_c
D_800B1ADA.rationale: records_screen.c/save_slot_overlay.c access it as RecordEntry.c, two bytes past D_800B1AD8 in the same record table.

D_800B1ADB.name: kaze_record_table_pad
D_800B1ADB.rationale: game_defaults.c zeroes it as the fourth byte of the RecordEntry{a,b,c,pad} struct alongside D_800B1AD8/9/A.

D_800B1ADC.name: kaze_record_table_score
D_800B1ADC.rationale: records_screen.c/save_slot_overlay.c/kaze_record_table_reset_defaults.c access it as the 4-byte RecordEntry.score field (offset +4 from D_800B1AD8's stride).

D_800B1C88.name: kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf
D_800B1C88.rationale: kaze_gs_graphics_init_9170 sets it to 0xC (OT length) and it is also indexed as an array of 20-byte double-buffer OT descriptors ('ot = D_800B1C88 + active*20') passed to GsSortObject4/GsDrawOt.

D_800B1C8C.name: kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org
D_800B1C8C.rationale: kaze_gs_graphics_init_9170: D_800B1C8C = packet-buffer pointer *p, the 'org' field of the buffer-0 GsOT struct that starts at D_800B1C88; also used as an AddPrim OT-pointer table in balloon_editor_prims.c.

D_800B1C9C.name: kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf1_length
D_800B1C9C.rationale: kaze_gs_graphics_init_9170 sets it to 0xC, the length field of the second (double-buffered) GsOT struct at D_800B1C88+0x14.

D_800B1CA0.name: kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf1_org
